name: multielement_airfoil_sanegrc
title: Three-element airfoil — SA-neg-RC numerical results
summary: FUN3D and USM3D results for the two-dimensional CRM-HL three-element airfoil with the SA-neg-RC turbulence model.

files.name: force_convergence_sanegrc.dat
files.description: Lift, drag, pressure drag, viscous drag, and pitching-moment convergence data.

files.name: cp_multielementairfoil_sanegrc.dat
files.description: Surface pressure coefficients from FUN3D and USM3D on the finest grid.

files.name: cfx_multielementairfoil_sanegrc.dat
files.description: Surface streamwise skin-friction coefficients from FUN3D and USM3D on the finest grid.

files.name: profiles_3element_sanegrc.dat
files.description: Velocity and eddy-viscosity profiles above the airfoil elements.

notes: NASA/TMBWG states that this case is not in the asymptotic grid-convergence regime and is not currently suitable as a formal verification case.
